policy.method: public web/search metadata and publicly viewable pages only
policy.engagementRule: Only directly visible/verifiable engagement is canonical; secondary or absent values remain non-canonical/null.
policy.rightsRule: Discovery does not grant reuse rights; source media stays ASSETS_PENDING until rights/privacy/human review.

candidates.title: 2026년 9월의 호시 일정 정리
candidates.engagementEvidence: Public TheQoo page/search result displayed 조회 수 34311 at capture time.
candidates.whyItMayWork: Korean-community-first candidate with a large directly visible view count and an image-led calendar/schedule format that is easy to understand visually.
candidates.whyItMayBeWeak: It is an ongoing fandom schedule rather than a single breaking story, and source imagery cannot be reused without clearance.

candidates.source: X/Twitter via NFL public post and public reporting
candidates.title: Taylor Swift and Tom Cruise shown together at Chiefs-Broncos MNF

secondaryEngagement.reportedViews: over 1.3 million within about one hour

candidates.whyItMayWork: A sports-plus-celebrity crossover with a short public video and strong reported early distribution creates obvious social-card potential.
candidates.whyItMayBeWeak: The 1.3M figure is secondary reporting rather than directly observed on X in this run, so it is deliberately non-canonical; media reuse needs rights clearance.

candidates.title: Former Google DeepMind researcher adds to catastrophic-AI warnings
candidates.whyItMayWork: A current AI-safety resignation/warning story has a strong debate hook and broad technology interest.
candidates.whyItMayBeWeak: The catastrophic-risk statement is an attributed forecast/opinion, not an observed outcome; sensational wording would distort the source.

candidates.title: MediaTek launches Dimensity 9600 Pro using TSMC 2nm technology
candidates.whyItMayWork: Flagship-phone hardware plus 2nm manufacturing and on-device AI performance gives several concrete visual/comparison hooks.
candidates.whyItMayBeWeak: Product specifications need careful sourcing and source/product imagery needs reuse clearance.

candidates.title: Einride and Lidl deploy cab-less autonomous truck on German public roads
candidates.whyItMayWork: A truck with no cab operating in regular logistics is instantly visual and creates a concrete automation/future-of-work story.
candidates.whyItMayBeWeak: Autonomy level and operating scope need to remain precise; source imagery cannot be assumed reusable.

candidates.title: Reuters/Ipsos poll finds US trust in childhood measles vaccine has fallen
candidates.whyItMayWork: The poll offers a concrete 2020-versus-2026 comparison that can be presented clearly without graphic imagery.
candidates.whyItMayBeWeak: Health information is sensitive and must preserve poll wording/context; this is better suited to careful explanatory treatment than outrage bait.

sameStoryGroups.note: Same underlying Reuters story appeared in an earlier batch; retain as refreshed hourly observation, not a new unique story.

dedupe.notes: No fabricated cross-platform engagement. X early-view figure remains secondary/non-canonical because it was not directly observed on X during this run.
